violations.reason: The agent cancelled reservation 0HUIH5 even though no cancellation condition was met. The user's stated reason was change of plan, but travel insurance only covers health or weather reasons; the reservation was economy, created on 2024-05-01, and there was no airline cancellation or business-class booking. The agent stated the user was eligible solely because of travel insurance and change of plans, then called cancel_reservation and completed the cancellation.
